references.text: The parable of the vineyard in Isaiah 5:1-7 has similarities with Jesus' parable in Matthew 21:34, where God expects righteousness from His people but finds bloodshed and cries.
Psalm 80:8-16 uses the image of a vineyard that God tends to, reflecting the theme in Matthew 21:34 about God's expectations and human betrayal.
The parable of the workers in the vineyard in Matthew 20:1-16 prepares the reader for the theme of God's kingdom and righteousness, which continues in Matthew 21:34.
The parable of the talents in Matthew 25:14-30 is also about being responsible for what one has been entrusted with, just like the servants in Matthew 21:34 who were sent to gather fruit.
